crudSummary.create: Add instruments to the active shopping cart, create customer checkout sessions, and apply valid promotional vouchers or bundle discounts.
crudSummary.read: Retrieve cart contents, inspect dynamic subtotal and delivery fee calculations (Western Province vs Outstation in LKR), and view pre-checkout order summaries.
crudSummary.update: Adjust product quantities in the cart, change selected shipping options, and modify or remove applied voucher codes before payment initiation.
crudSummary.delete: Remove individual instrument line items from the shopping cart or clear the entire cart upon order cancellation or checkout completion.

assignedErrors.name: Requested Quantity Exceeds Available Warehouse Stock
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when customer attempts to add or update an item quantity greater than live inventory balance.
assignedErrors.message: Only [X] unit(s) of "[Instrument Name]" available in stock. You requested [Y].

assignedErrors.name: Invalid, Expired, or Sub-Threshold Coupon Code
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when an entered coupon code is not found in the active coupons database, has expired, or does not meet the minimum order subtotal requirement.
assignedErrors.message: Coupon code is invalid or has expired. Or minimum spend threshold (e.g. Rs. 20,000 for MELODY10) not reached.

assignedErrors.name: Empty Cart Checkout Session Initiation Attempt
assignedErrors.condition: Triggered when a checkout session is initiated with zero instrument items in the active cart.
assignedErrors.message: Cannot initiate checkout with an empty cart. Please add musical instruments before proceeding.

endpointsTested: POST /api/cart/validate-item - Real-time stock validation prior to cart addition/update
POST /api/cart/validate-coupon - Verify and apply promo codes (MELODY10, NEWYEAR26)
POST /api/cart/calculate - Dynamic subtotal, Sri Lanka delivery fee, tax calculation
POST /api/cart/checkout-session - Initialize checkout session with active cart
